text:
devx_kate: Hey team — customer DeltaPay is hitting truncated streaming responses. Client parses SSE fine during stream but the final JSON chunk never arrives; finish_reason is absent and JSON ends mid-object. Ticket: #DP-9321.

support_lee: Ugh, thanks. Can you paste minimal repro curl + any logs? Also what client lib and mobile/desktop?

qa_ines: Quick note: I can repro locally with a simulated token rotation. Steps: 1) start curl --no-buffer against /v1/streams/generate 2) after ~8–12s call auth rotate endpoint 3) connection drops and final sentinel not received.

devx_kate: Repro curl we used:
```bash
curl -v --no-buffer -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams/generate \n  -d '{"prompt":"stream test","max_tokens":64}'
```
Observed client-side parse error: "Unexpected end of JSON input".

dev_alex: Pasted server SSE output (from our edge):
```
event: message
data: {"id":"req-8a2","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hello worl"}}

```
(note: missing closing brackets and no finish_reason event)

maria_ops: Similar incidents when a billing plan swap or KMS key rotation coincided with long-lived streams. Our LB (fastly/nginx) sometimes RSTs idle connections during backend config handoff. Client sees truncated tail.

delta_dev: Customer uses node-fetch in a React Native WebView. Their reconnect logic tries to resume but the resume header we send doesn't match because the client reconnects with a new ephemeral token and our resume index check rejects the resume.

ingrid_sre: Hypothesis: two contributing issues — (1) mid-request auth rotation/billing swap triggers proxy/edge to close connection without passing final chunk, (2) buffering at proxy discards tail when conn is reset.

support_lee: For immediate mitigation recommend: add SSE keepalive (":heartbeat\n\n") every 10s, ensure server flushes chunked response after final event, and let client fall back to polling if resume fails. Can you also grab tcpdump on the edge and the LB logs for timestamps around the repro?

qa_ines: Confirmed heartbeat prevents most truncations in my local env. When heartbeat is present, LB keeps connection alive and final sentinel arrives.

dev_alex: Proposed server change: emit explicit final event with finish_reason, then flush and sleep 50ms before socket close. Example final event:
```
event: done
data: {"finish_reason":"stop","id":"req-8a2"}

```
Also ensure chunked transfer-encoding and disable response buffering on proxied layers.

devx_kate: Customer-side workaround: update client to accept partial resume (tolerate missing final token and request the last N tokens via a secondary non-stream call) and add retry on parse error. I asked DeltaPay to try heartbeat client-side and to share logs.

ingrid_sre: Long-term: add server-side resume token header semantics so clients can resume even after token rotation, and coordinate auth rotation with draining policy for active streams.

deploy-bot: Info: canary rollout scheduled for "sse-heartbeat-flush" patch at 1718327400.

support_lee: Thanks — I'm looping in account team and will update customer with the mitigation steps. If you can attach tcpdump + edge logs, I'll escalate to infra for LB config change. :thumbsup:

devx_kate: Will follow up with logs and timeline once I get them from the customer. Assigned to eng-runtime for follow-up.
